'''Eagan Padros''' was the leader of the rebel [[Illian]] soldiers loyal to [[Sammael|Lord Brend]]. 

==Appearance==
He had a narrow face and a runny nose.

==Activities==
[[Rand al'Thor]] meets with Padros outside Illian after the defeat of Lord Brend. 

The rebels decide to join Rand's army and Padros served under Rand when he attacks the [[Seanchan]] trying to invade Illian.

He tries to assassinate Rand and narrowly misses, probably due to Rand's ''[[ta'veren]]'' nature. He is then killed by surrounding [[Asha'man]] by means of Power-wrought [[Fire ball]]s.
